auth.description: nexusauth validator-chain block (same shape as nexus.io.agui and the broker). Absent means every caller is admitted.

include_events.description: Operator ceiling: only these types are streamed. Exact type, or a trailing * for a prefix match (llm.*, before:*, *). Empty means all.

exclude_events.description: Operator ceiling: these types are never streamed. Exact type, or a trailing * for a prefix match (llm.*, before:*, *).

ring_size.description: Frames held in memory for resume and ring backfill. Defaults to 8192.

client_buffer.description: Per-client queue depth; a client that falls this far behind is disconnected with an overflow frame. Defaults to 1024.

heartbeat_interval.description: SSE keepalive comment interval (Go duration). Defaults to 15s; 0 disables.
